\section*{Chapter 31 - Data Schemas}


\subsection*{Purpose}

This chapter provides reference documentation for AIM-OS data schemas including CMC atom schema, HHNI node schema, VIF witness schema, SEG graph schema, and APOE plan schema. Schemas enable developers to understand data structures and integrate with AIM-OS.

\subsection*{Executive Summary}

\item Data schemas define structure for all AIM-OS data: atoms, nodes, witnesses, graphs, and plans.
\item Schema validation: schemas enable validation and ensure data integrity.
\item Integration: schemas enable external systems to integrate with AIM-OS.

\subsection*{CMC Atom Schema}

``\texttt{json
{
  "atom\_id": "uuid",
  "modality": "text|image|binary|reference",
  "content": "string|uri",
  "embedding": "vector[1536]",
  "tags": ["string"],
  "tx\_time": "timestamp",
  "valid\_time": "timestamp",
  "vif\_witness": {
    "model\_id": "string",
    "prompt": "string",
    "tools": ["string"],
    "confidence": 0.0-1.0
  },
  "predecessor\_id": "uuid|null"
}
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Fields:}
\item }atom\_id\texttt{: Unique identifier (UUID)
\item }modality\texttt{: Content type (text, image, binary, reference)
\item }content\texttt{: Inline content or URI reference
\item }embedding\texttt{: Vector embedding for retrieval
\item }tags\texttt{: Metadata tags for filtering
\item }tx\_time\texttt{: Transaction time (when recorded)
\item }valid\_time\texttt{: Valid time (when true)
\item }vif\_witness\texttt{: VIF witness envelope
\item }predecessor\_id\texttt{: Link to predecessor atom (bitemporal)

\subsection*{HHNI Node Schema}

}`\texttt{json
{
  "node\_id": "uuid",
  "level": 0-5,
  "content": "string",
  "embedding": "vector[1536]",
  "children": ["uuid"],
  "parents": ["uuid"],
  "metadata": {
    "tier": "S|A|B|C",
    "authority": 0.0-1.0,
    "tags": ["string"]
  }
}
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Fields:}
\item }node\_id\texttt{: Unique identifier (UUID)
\item }level\texttt{: HHNI level (0-5)
\item }content\texttt{: Node content
\item }embedding\texttt{: Vector embedding
\item }children\texttt{: Child node IDs
\item }parents\texttt{: Parent node IDs
\item }metadata\texttt{: Node metadata (tier, authority, tags)

\subsection*{VIF Witness Schema}

}`\texttt{json
{
  "witness\_id": "uuid",
  "operation\_id": "uuid",
  "model\_id": "string",
  "prompt": "string",
  "tools": ["string"],
  "output": "string",
  "confidence": 0.0-1.0,
  "timestamp": "timestamp",
  "hash": "sha256"
}
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Fields:}
\item }witness\_id\texttt{: Unique identifier (UUID)
\item }operation\_id\texttt{: Operation identifier
\item }model\_id\texttt{: Model identifier
\item }prompt\texttt{: Input prompt
\item }tools\texttt{: Tools used
\item }output\texttt{: Operation output
\item }confidence\texttt{: Confidence score (0.0-1.0)
\item }timestamp\texttt{: Operation timestamp
\item }hash\texttt{: Cryptographic hash for validation

\subsection*{SEG Graph Schema}

}`\texttt{json
{
  "graph\_id": "uuid",
  "nodes": [
    {
      "node\_id": "uuid",
      "type": "claim|source|derivation|agent",
      "content": "string",
      "tx\_time": "timestamp",
      "valid\_time": "timestamp"
    }
  ],
  "edges": [
    {
      "edge\_id": "uuid",
      "source": "uuid",
      "target": "uuid",
      "type": "supports|contradicts|derives|witnesses",
      "weight": 0.0-1.0
    }
  ]
}
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Fields:}
\item }graph\_id\texttt{: Unique identifier (UUID)
\item }nodes\texttt{: Graph nodes (claims, sources, derivations, agents)
\item }edges\texttt{: Graph edges (supports, contradicts, derives, witnesses)
\item }tx\_time\texttt{: Transaction time (bitemporal)
\item }valid\_time\texttt{: Valid time (bitemporal)

\subsection*{APOE Plan Schema}

}`\texttt{json
{
  "plan\_id": "uuid",
  "steps": [
    {
      "step\_id": "uuid",
      "role": "planner|retriever|reasoner|verifier|builder|critic|operator|witness",
      "action": "string",
      "inputs": {},
      "outputs": {},
      "budget": {
        "tokens": 0,
        "cost": 0.0,
        "time": 0
      },
      "gates": ["string"]
    }
  ],
  "dependencies": ["uuid"],
  "budget": {
    "total\_tokens": 0,
    "total\_cost": 0.0,
    "total\_time": 0
  }
}
}`\texttt{

\textbf{Fields:}
\item }plan\_id\texttt{: Unique identifier (UUID)
\item }steps\texttt{: Plan steps with roles, actions, budgets, gates
\item }dependencies\texttt{: Step dependencies
\item }budget\texttt{: Total plan budget

\subsubsection*{Pattern 3: Schema Migration}

\textbf{Use Case:} Migrate schemas when versions change

\textbf{Steps:}
1. Detect schema version mismatch
2. Transform old schema to new schema
3. Validate new schema
4. Store migrated atom

\textbf{Example:}
}`\texttt{powershell
\section*{Migrate atom schema v1.0 → v2.0}
function Migrate-AtomSchema {
    param(\_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_37\_\_targetVersion)
    
    \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_38\_\_oldAtom.atom\_id
        schema\_version = \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_39\_\_oldAtom.modality
        content = \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_40\_\_oldAtom.embedding
        tags = \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_41\_\_oldAtom.tx\_time
        valid\_time = @{
            valid\_from = \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_42\_\_oldAtom.valid\_to
        }
        vif\_witness = \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_43\_\_oldAtom.predecessor\_id
        \# New fields in v2.0
        hhni\_path = \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_44\_\_oldAtom.snapshot\_id
        metadata = \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_45\_\_errors = Validate-CMCAtom -atom \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_46\_\_errors.Count -gt 0) {
        throw "Migration failed: \_\_MATH\_BLOCK\_47\_\_errors -join ', ')"
    }
    
    return $newAtom
}
}`\texttt{

\subsection*{Schema Evolution}

AIM-OS schemas evolve over time with versioning:

\subsubsection*{Versioning Strategy}

\textbf{Semantic Versioning:}
\item \textbf{MAJOR:} Breaking changes (require migration)
\item \textbf{MINOR:} New fields (backward compatible)
\item \textbf{PATCH:} Bug fixes (backward compatible)

\textbf{Migration Rules:}
\item Old schemas remain valid (backward compatibility)
\item New fields optional (default values)
\item Breaking changes require explicit migration
\item Migration scripts provided for major versions

\subsubsection*{Version History}

\textbf{CMC Atom Schema:}
\item v1.0.0: Initial schema (2025-10-01)
\item v1.1.0: Added }hhni\_path\texttt{ field (2025-10-15)
\item v2.0.0: Added }snapshot\_id\texttt{, }metadata\texttt{ fields (2025-11-01)

\textbf{HHNI Node Schema:}
\item v1.0.0: Initial schema (2025-10-01)
\item v1.1.0: Added }atom\_ids\texttt{ to metadata (2025-10-20)

\textbf{VIF Witness Schema:}
\item v1.0.0: Initial schema (2025-10-01)
\item v1.1.0: Added }confidence\_type` field (2025-10-25)

\subsection*{Integration Points}

Data schemas integrate deeply with all AIM-OS systems:

\subsubsection*{CMC (Chapter 5)}

\textbf{CMC provides:} Atom storage and retrieval  
\textbf{Schemas provide:} Structure for CMC atoms  
\textbf{Integration:} CMC validates atom schemas on store/retrieve

\subsubsection*{HHNI (Chapter 6)}

\textbf{HHNI provides:} Hierarchical indexing  
\textbf{Schemas provide:} Structure for HHNI nodes  
\textbf{Integration:} HHNI validates node schemas on index/query

\subsubsection*{VIF (Chapter 7)}

\textbf{VIF provides:} Confidence tracking  
\textbf{Schemas provide:} Structure for VIF witnesses  
\textbf{Integration:} VIF validates witness schemas on create/verify

\subsubsection*{SEG (Chapter 9)}

\textbf{SEG provides:} Evidence graph  
\textbf{Schemas provide:} Structure for graph nodes/edges  
\textbf{Integration:} SEG validates graph schemas on add/query

\subsubsection*{APOE (Chapter 8)}

\textbf{APOE provides:} Orchestration  
\textbf{Schemas provide:} Structure for APOE plans  
\textbf{Integration:} APOE validates plan schemas on create/execute
